name: Fun-first visual catalogs and annotations
statement: Users can accomplish fun-first visual catalogs and annotations while preserving user-owned meaning, usability and consent.
requiredProperties: One-click Save and native bookmark import with original provenance
Sortable pinned catalog icons and beautiful accessible list, masonry, gallery and editorial views
All items, folders, tags, documents, video, files, image galleries and images have optional independent title, notes and tags
Multiple dated user notes and user-authored meanings; no forced metadata
Relationships have their own typed labels, why-connected text and tags
Clickable exact counts for attached galleries, documents, connections, videos and files
